text: Either we pass the pension reform this year or the state goes bankrupt.
A vote against the pension reform is a vote to bankrupt the state.
Either the pension reform is promulgated within 20 days or it returns to parliament, as the constitution provides.
The pension reform was debated for three days, and the committee proposed several amendments.
Water is either privatized or the taps run dry; there is no third way.
Whoever defends public water utilities wants the taps to run dry.
The water utility is either owned by the municipality or by a private concessionaire; the register lists which.
The council commissioned a study of how the water utility could be financed and managed.
We either build the border fence or surrender the country to criminals.
Opposing the border fence means inviting criminals to walk in.
The fence section is either on state land or on private land, and the survey records which.
Border officials described the planned fence as one measure among several under review.
It's the energy tax or blackouts; those are the only two possibilities.
Anyone who refuses the energy tax has chosen blackouts for our children.
The energy tax is levied either per kilowatt-hour or as a flat monthly fee, depending on the contract.
The ministry published a table showing how the energy tax would affect different households.
Either we impose the curfew or the streets belong to the gangs.
Teachers who question the curfew have decided the gangs should win the streets.
The curfew applies either from 22:00 or from midnight, depending on the district.
Residents' associations gave mixed reactions to the proposed curfew at the hearing.
You are either for the vaccine mandate or you are for the next epidemic.
Skeptics of the vaccine mandate are, plainly, rooting for the next epidemic.
Under the rules, staff are either vaccinated or must present a negative test.
The health board asked clinics to report uptake figures before the mandate review.
Either landlords are forced to cut rents or families sleep on the street.
A senator who will not back the housing law has abandoned every family that rents.
A tenant can either renew the lease or leave on the date stated in the contract.
The housing law adds notice periods and a registry of rental contracts.
We either raise defense spending to three percent or we leave our borders open to invasion.
Cut a single euro from the defense budget and you hand the country to its enemies.
The budget is either approved by 31 December or the government continues under provisional rules.
Analysts compared the defense budget with previous years and with neighboring states.
Either the media law passes or lies will rule the airwaves.
Journalists who object to the media law have taken the side of the liars.
The regulator can either grant a license or refuse it in writing within thirty days.
The draft media law sets out licensing procedures and complaint mechanisms.
It's a higher minimum wage or mass poverty, and nothing in between.
Employers who resist the wage increase want workers to starve.
The minimum wage is set either by government decree or, failing that, by the statutory formula.
The wage commission will meet in March to review the minimum wage.
We either tax foreign steel or we lose every steelworker's job.
Free-trade advocates are happy to see the steel towns die.
Imports of steel are either subject to the tariff or covered by an exemption listed in the annex.
Steel producers, unions and importers submitted written comments on the proposed tariff.
Either the police get full access to our phones or terrorists win.
Privacy campaigners have decided that terrorists deserve protection.
Data are retained either for six months or, with a court order, for twelve.
The data-retention law sets storage periods and defines who may request access.
Either the strikers go back to work on Monday or the city is paralyzed forever.
The union leaders who keep the strike going want the city to burn.
The strike is either lawful or unlawful depending on whether notice was given, and the court will decide.
Commuters used alternative routes while negotiations continued through the weekend.
It is either total protection for the forest or logging to the last tree.
Anyone who allows a single permit in the forest is the enemy of nature.
A permit for the forest is either issued by the regional office or by the national agency, according to plot size.
The forest act classifies plots by size and lists the activities allowed in each.
